home.tagline: The secure base for a modular SaaS platform.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use the email and password of your {appName} account.

arrival.callback: We could not complete authentication. Try signing in again.
arrival.expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.

forgotPassword.title: Recover password
forgotPassword.description: We will send you a link to set a new password.

resetPassword.title: Set new password
resetPassword.description: Choose the password you will use to sign in.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.

suspended.title: Account suspended
suspended.description: This identity is blocked and cannot perform operations.
suspended.notice: If you believe this is a mistake, contact the person in charge at your company or platform support.

denied.title: Access denied
denied.description: Your account is active, but it does not have permission for this resource.
denied.notice: Ask whoever manages the environment for access.
denied.ipNotice: Your network address is not on this area's IP allow list. Talk to whoever manages the account.

messages.recoverySent: If an account exists with this email, we have sent a recovery link.
messages.passwordUpdated: Password updated. You can now sign in.
messages.signedOut: You have signed out of your account.

errors.recoveryLinkInvalid: The recovery link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.weakPassword: Use a password with at least 12 characters.
